taxonomy.simulator_failure: exception or non-finite state inside the runtime (run aborted)
taxonomy.numerical_failure: non-finite runtime state detected by the benchmark (run aborted)
taxonomy.benchmark_failure: exception in benchmark code outside the runtime (run aborted)
taxonomy.comparator_failure: comparator exception, non-finite belief/free energy, or zero-evidence inference (run continued)
taxonomy.model_structure_failure: fixed generative model's predictive validity < 0.5 of the unperturbed reference
taxonomy.controller_failure: controller success in the perturbation phase > 0.2 below no control (same cell, seed)
taxonomy.genuine_regime_transition: cell-seed labelled TRANSITION or POST_ACTIVE_INFERENCE with no aborted run

note: no run is discarded; aborted runs are excluded from metrics that need them and listed here
